answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the mirror to sunk effort, uses the cedar as an corroborating signal, then requires a velvet before any payout.
